name: Serper
description: OpenClaw Serper.dev Google SERP provider with native mini-batches of up to 100 queries.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Serper API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Serper.dev API key (fallback: SERPER_API_KEY env var).

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Serper Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional Serper-compatible API base URL. Defaults to https://google.serper.dev.

webSearch.fallbacks.label: Fallback providers
webSearch.fallbacks.help: Optional ordered fallback list. Use an empty list to run Serper only.
